summary: Full backend + frontend e2e for CareCompanion patient app iteration. All 15 pytest backend tests pass (auth, patient profile, PIN lockout, sync push idempotency, sync pull, voice validation). All 17 frontend UI checks pass (setup → home, tiles, Call Family modal, three offline games persist sessions to localStorage under cc:game_sessions with correct game_id, reminders write cc:reminder_logs on Done, notes write cc:sticky_notes, syncNow sets cc:kv:lastSynced, language switch localizes patient-facing labels).
critical_code_review_comments: flip-cards and whack-the-ball on quit call router.back() without showing GameResult — that is a deliberate UX choice (session is still recorded before back) but the review request implied game-result should appear on quit for Flip Cards; consider showing GameResult before navigating back for consistency with number-cards behavior.

Setup screen tries caregiverLogin first and falls back to signup on any error — this produces a benign 401 in the console on first-time setup. Consider surfacing 'signing in vs creating account' distinction, or suppressing that expected 401.
PIN brute-force lockout counter is in-process memory (security.py _attempts dict) — will reset on any backend restart and won't scale across workers. Move to Mongo or Redis for production.
test_credentials: New caregiver signed up per-run with tester_<rand>@example.com / secret1; patient PIN 1234. Existing seeded caregiver@example.com / secret1 also present.
seed_data_creation: Each pytest session creates a fresh caregiver + patient. Frontend test clears localStorage and does a fresh device setup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend base URL is EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL / preview URL; routes under /api/v1, health at /api/health. Local MongoDB (Atlas unreachable). Patient session token uses header X-Patient-PIN-Token; caregiver uses Authorization: Bearer. Voice TTS 422 for as-IN/mni-IN is expected; en-IN accepted (may return 502/504 if Sarvam unreachable). Frontend is Expo web on the same preview URL — use domcontentloaded + explicit selector waits (Metro HMR keeps networkidle open). Games persist to localStorage key cc:game_sessions; flip-quit and whack-quit navigate back without showing GameResult but DO record the session with quit_event=true. Frontend test suite is idempotent (clears localStorage before start).
rca of the issue: N/A — no failing bugs; all covered flows work end-to-end.
